## Skill or catalog change

Describe the outcome and link the submission issue when available.

## Attribution and permission

Identify author, submitter, and reviewer separately. State permission evidence and any limits.

## Validation

- [ ] Package validation, unit tests, catalog check, and ZIP build pass.
- [ ] Generated README/detail pages match metadata.
- [ ] Released content changes use a new version.
- [ ] No private paths, credentials, backups, source books, or unlicensed assets are included.
- [ ] Practical test claims name the exact versions and observed results, or explicitly say untested.

Maintainer review and protected-branch merge are required before release automation can publish.
